days.note: Plymouth is ON the route — Rt 3 passes its front door, so the Rock costs ~45 min, not a detour. Expectation management, with love: it is a modest boulder under a grand Greek portico, and that gap IS the charm — you two are collecting the story, not the geology. Mayflower II beside it is the better photograph. Then the day resumes: NH is drive-through today (its night comes Tuesday), Vermont by mid-afternoon, cider donuts as the state’s handshake.
